x: On the next leg T.V.H. pulled out their trump card in the form of Mike Wiggs who with a great run knocked off 10 secs. from Jim Peters's stage record set in 1953 and this time in turn was bettered by Bruce Tulloh running in the lead position who ran even 30 secs. faster than Wiggs.
With two miles left Gerry was on his own with Tulloh and Roberts fighting it out 50yds ahead and Mike Wiggs moving up very fast through the field behind.

Joe was unable to maintain our sub-16 sequence but the latter stages of these longer races are notoriously slower, which may be of some consolation, but only serves to underline the speed of Valley's Mike Wiggs who broke John Thresher's 1½ hour old record with a time of 15:13!
